# YaPB

> YaPB is an open-source bot for Counter-Strike 1.6 and Condition Zero,
> based on PODBot by Count Floyd. Maintained by the YaPB Team.
> Released into the public domain under The Unlicense.

## Download

- [Latest stable release](https://github.com/yapb/yapb/releases/latest): production-ready build.
- [Continuous build](https://github.com/yapb/yapb/releases/tag/continuous): rolling development build (beta).
- Each release ships Windows (.zip archive and .exe installer), Linux (.tar.xz), and Extras (.zip) assets.
- [All releases](https://github.com/yapb/yapb/releases)

## Docs

- [Documentation (English)](https://yapb.github.io/docs/en): install, setup, commands, configuration.
- [Documentation (Russian)](https://yapb.github.io/docs/ru): установка, настройка, команды, конфигурация.

## Source code

- [GitHub](https://github.com/yapb/yapb): primary repository, releases, issue tracker.
- [SourceCraft](https://sourcecraft.dev/yapb/yapb): mirror repository.
- [Codeberg](https://codeberg.org/yapb/yapb): mirror repository.

## Waypoints (graphs)

- [Graph database](https://github.com/yapb/graph): per-map navigation files.
- [All graphs (.zip)](https://github.com/yapb/graph/archive/master.zip): full snapshot.
